## Problem

State what was wrong. Give the symptom that a reader can recognise, and say who or what it
affects. Do not describe the fix here.

## What this changes

State what the change makes true. Explain why this approach was chosen, and name any
approach that was measured and rejected.

## Before and after

Show the behaviour on both sides. Use a table for counts and a code block for output.

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| | | |

## Example

Give one or two concrete cases. A short input and the output on both sides is enough.
Leave this section out when the change has no user-visible example.

## Verification

State what was run and what it reported. Name any measurement over a real repository, and
give the counts.

---

Writing rules for this file and for every document in the repository:

- Write in the active voice. Use full sentences with a subject and an object.
- Keep sentences short. One idea per sentence.
- Do not write "instead of". State what is true, then state what is not true if the
  contrast is needed.
- Use the terms defined in `docs/terminology.md`. Do not invent a second word for an idea
  that already has one.
- Do not use a term that is specific to this project until `docs/terminology.md` defines it.
- Avoid words joined by hyphens into new terms. Write the words out.
- Remove any sentence that does not tell the reader something they need.
